mapper.select: SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, COALESCE( STRING_AGG(DISTINCT g.genre_name, ', ' ORDER BY g.genre_name), '미분류' ) AS genres FROM movies m LEFT JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.movie_id = mg.movie_id LEFT JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title ORDER BY m.movie_id ASC
